profile.headline: Principal Software Engineer at Dematic & Co-Founder of RYSE
profile.summary: Software engineer and co-founder of RYSE - a social fitness app (think the Instagram of fitness) RYSE has 35,000+ users worldwide and is available on iOS, Android, and web. Learn more at ryseapp.io

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
Currently focused on:
- Architecting event-driven tenant onboarding and provisioning systems across microservices and cloud infrastructure, enabling scalable multi-tenant growth.
- Driving standardization of inter-service contracts and onboarding workflows to improve integration reliability and reduce cross-team friction.
- Leading service reliability efforts, including SLI/SLO definition, observability improvements, and operational readiness across critical services.
- Owning platform stability and scalability initiatives, including disaster recovery strategy, failover design, and environment standardization across dev/stage/prod.

positions.title: Co-Founder
positions.description:
- Cofounder & Lead Developer of RYSE, a social fitness app with 20,000+ users worldwide
- Cross-platform availability: iOS, Android, and Web
     - Cordova / Capacitor hybrid app with React 19 / Typescript
- Built entirely by myself and my cofounder, from backend to frontend
- AI-powered fitness assistant, integrated with OpenAI to provide intelligent workout guidance
       - Agent-like chat interface 
- AWS-powered backend, leveraging AWS CDK for infrastructure as code:
       - GraphQL API with AppSync
       - Single-table DynamoDB design for scalable performance
       - Event-driven architecture using EventBridge & NodeJS Lambdas
       - Data processing with EventBridge Pipes to Postgres RDS using Prisma
       - Additional services: S3, Step Functions, Cognito, Pinpoint

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Designed and developed a full-stack, B2C security web/mobile application integrating SpyCloud APIs, AWS Events, AppSync, and DynamoDB.
- Empowered customers to monitor security vulnerabilities, improving user engagement and proactively reducing customer churn.
- Implemented scalable cloud-based architecture, leveraging AWS services to ensure reliability and performance.
- Optimized data flow and event-driven processing, enhancing real-time security insights and dark web monitoring for users.
- Built strong relationships with cross-functional teams, collaborating closely with UX designers, engineers, and product managers to ensure cohesive and successful software development.
- Provided technical leadership and mentorship, guiding engineers in best practices, architecture decisions, and cloud-based development.

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer & Engineering Manager
positions.description:
- Led the development of a B2C video chat kiosk, enabling seamless customer support for mobile claims.
- Empowered engineers through hiring, coaching, mentorship, and career development, fostering growth across all experience levels.
- Optimized cross-team collaboration, aligning product, design, and engineering efforts to efficiently deliver impactful features.
